source: 650 Reaper
target: 650 Messor

source: In the ancient, crumbling palace of the Nation of the Evernight, Lumian carefully poured Gardner Martin’s blood into a measuring cylinder and added the unusually sharp, small white bone blade that emitted a cold light.
target: In antiquo palatio ruente Nationis Noctis Aeternae, Lumian sanguinem Gardner Martin diligenter in cylindrum mensuratorium effudit et adiecit lamina ossis alba parva ac acutissima, quae lumen frigide fulgebat.

source: During this process, he moved swiftly, paying no attention to the bone-blade-shaped Beyonder characteristic slicing his fingers and causing blood to flow.
target: Inter hoc processum, celeriter movebat, non attendens ad Beyonder formam lamina ossis habentem, qui digitos eius secabat et sanguinem effundebat.

source: Instead, he ignited crimson flames, helping the wounds contract and preventing the white bone blade from entering the potion with his blood.
target: Pro eo, incendit flammas coccineas, quae vulnera ad contractionem adiuvabant et vitabant ut lamina ossis albae cum sanguine eius in potionem intraret.

source: The physical pain heightened Lumian’s clarity and excitement.
target: Dolor corporis claritatem atque fervorem Lumiani auxit.

source: He added Gardner Martin’s two teeth, the Colorful Bearded Horned Lizard’s venom, and the hornbeam essential oil into the bright red blood.
target: Ad sanguinem rubrum nitidum, adiecit duo dentes Gardner Martin, venenum lacertae barbatae cornutae coloratae, atque oleum essentiale carpini.

source: Bloop! Bloop! Bubbles bubbled in the blood, and the items mysteriously dissolved.
target: Bloop! Bloop! Bullae in sanguine bullabant, et res mysteriose dissolutae erant.

source: Soon, black iron dregs emerged from the bright-red blood, as if an iron weapon had shattered inside.
target: Mox ex sanguine rubro nitido emerserunt sedimenta nigra ferri, quasi telum ferreum intus confractum esset.

source: Lumian glanced at the still-slumbering “Hisoka” Twanaku, picked up the measuring cylinder, and poured the liquid into his mouth.
target: Lumian conspexit “Hisoka” Twanaku, qui adhuc dormiens erat, ac cylindrum mensuratorium arripuit, liquoremque in os suum effudit.

source: The pungent smell of blood, the unfamiliar taste of rust, and the burning sensation instantly filled Lumian’s mouth and pierced his brain.
target: Odor acri sanguinis, gustus rubiginis ignotus, atque sensus ardens statim os Lumiani impleverunt atque cerebrum eius penetraverunt.

source: It felt like being caught in a chaotic war, constantly facing blades, firearms, and relentless enemy assaults.
target: Videbatur quasi in bello confuso captus esse, ubi constanter adversus laminae, arma ignifera, atque incursiones hostium inexorabiles se exhiberent.

source: Wounds appeared all over his body, throbbing with pain.
target: Vulnera per totum corpus eius apparuerunt, dolore pulsantia.

source: Son of a sow, am I being attacked by a potion? Lumian muttered, bewildered, as he found himself locked in combat with a swarm of oncoming adversaries.
target: Filius porci, num potio me oppugnet? Lumian pertonitus murmuravit, dum se in pugna cum turba hostium adventantium inclusum invenit.

source: Fireballs, Fire Ravens, and blazing white spears shattered, tore through, or impaled the enemies, turning them into torches that illuminated the battlefield.
target: Pilae ignis, corvi igniti, et hastae albae ardentes inimicos confrangerunt, dissecaverunt aut transfixerunt, eos in faces vertentes qui campum proelii illuminabant.

source: After an unknown span of time, Lumian felt his strength waning, his spiritual energy on the brink of exhaustion.
target: Post ignotum tempus, Lumian sensit virtutem suam labefactari et energiam spiritualem in limine exhauritionis esse.

source: The accumulated spirituality of an Ascetic had long been unleashed.
target: Spiritualitas accumulata ascetica iam diutius effusa erat.

source: In that moment, a colossal figure materialized before him, radiating a formidable and intimidating aura.
target: Illo momento, figura colossalis coram eo apparuit, aura formidabilis atque terribilis effulgens.

source: Despite Lumian’s weakening state, he sensed the colossal figure’s fear, hatred, and frustration.
target: Non obstante statu debilitato Lumiani, sensit timorem, odium atque frustrationem figurae colossalis.

source: He’s afraid of me…
target: Mihi timet…

source: Lumian realized suddenly.
target: Lumian subito intellexit.

source: Summoning the last shreds of his courage, he condensed a blazing white flaming spear and hurled it at the colossal figure.
target: Ultimas fortitudinis particulas evocans, hastam albam ardentem concentravit et in figuram colossalem iecit.

source: A blinding white flame erupted, piercing through the colossal figure’s head.
target: Flamma alba caeca erupta est, caput figurae colossalis transiens.

source: Rumble.
target: Tonitrua.

source: The giant figure exploded from within, shattering into countless fragments.
target: Figura gigantea ex intus explosa est, in innumerabiles partes confracta.

source: Rumble.
target: Tonitrua.

source: The entire battlefield crumbled.
target: Totum campum proelii corruperit.

source: Lumian shook off the daze and found himself in front of a crumbling ancient palace, its stone bricks weathered by time.
target: Lumian stupefactus se abiecit et conspexit se ante antiquum palatium ruentem, cujus lateres lapidei tempore ducti erant.

source: Hisoka Twanaku still slumbered, and Hela stood silently by his side.
target: Hisoka Twanaku adhuc dormiebat, et Hela iuxta eum silentio stabat.

source: Sweat dripped from Lumian’s body, bursting into crimson sparks.
target: Sudor e corpore Lumiani stillabat, in scintillas coccineas erumpens.

source: Eventually, the sweat returned to normal.
target: Postremo, sudor ad statum suum rediit.

source: Phew… Lumian let out a relieved breath.
target: Phwe... Lumian animum levatum suspiravit.

source: His spirituality was rapidly recovering.
target: Spiritualitas eius celeriter recuperabatur.

source: He had advanced to become a Reaper.
target: Adcessit ut Messor fieret.

source: Having completed the ritual of capturing a higher Sequence enemy alive and revealing his conspiracy, Lumian had consumed the potion and advanced to Sequence 5, a Reaper of the Hunter pathway.
target: Exsecutus ritum captivandi hostem superioris Sequentiae vivum et coniurationem eius detegendi, Lumian potionem consumpsit et ad Sequentiam V, Messor in via Venatoris, provectus est.

source: Compared to his previous Sequences, Reaper bestowed three additional abilities:
target: Comparato sequentiarum praecedentium statu, Messor tres facultates additas praebuit:

source: The first, Weakness Investigation, allowed Lumian to discern the target’s vulnerabilities and weak points in their defenses from a mystic perspective.
target: Primum, Inquisitio Debilitatum, Lumiano concessit ut infirmitates et puncta debilia in defensionibus obiecti ex prospectu mystico discerneret.

source: The second, Cull, could be infused into any attack to harvest the target’s life.
target: Secundum, Cull, in quemlibet impetu infundi poterat ad vitam obiecti metiendam.

source: Any part struck by Cull was akin to an assault on vital points and weaknesses, dealing significant damage.
target: Quaecumque pars a Cull percussa comparabatur impetu in puncta vitalia et infirmitates, ingentem damnum afferens.

source: If Cull hit a genuine weakness or vital point, it could deliver a fatal blow, making it challenging for the target to withstand three consecutive attacks.
target: Si Cull infirmitatem aut punctum vitalem verum percuteret, ictum mortiferum inferre poterat, difficilius rei faciens ut tres impetus consecutivi obiecto sustinerentur.

source: It could even inflict real damage on demigod-level creatures, provided they didn’t block or successfully evade, and refrained from using mystic defenses.
target: Etiam damnum verum in creaturas ad gradum semidei inferre poterat, dummodo neque obsisterent neque feliciter evaderent, atque defensionibus mysticis non uterentur.

source: The third, Precision, enabled Lumian to precisely target a predetermined location and manipulate fireballs, Fire Ravens, and other spells that had left his body.
target: Tertium, Praecisio, Lumiano permisit ut locum praedeterminatum precisa mente selegeret atque pilas ignis, corvos ignitos, atque alias incantationes, quae ex corpore eius expulsa erant, manipularentur.

source: He could split a colossal fireball into hundreds, striking different targets with precision, achieving effective area-of-effect damage.
target: Poterat colossalem pilam igniferam in centena dividere, diversas metas cum praecisione percutiens, damnum efficax in regione afferens.

source: It was a far cry from a blanket explosion, being more efficient and effective.
target: Haec longe differebat ab explosioni universali, efficacior atque utilior.

source: Both Cull and Precision demanded a substantial amount of spirituality, rivaling Lumian’s current usage of teleportation.
target: Et Cull et Praecisio magna quantitate spiritualis exigerunt, comparantis usui teleportationis Lumiani hodiernae.

source: The exception was the combination of Precision and Fire Raven, as Fire Raven could allocate a bit of spirituality and was easily manipulated.
target: Exemptio erat compositio Praecisionis et Corvi Igniti, quippe quod Corvus Ignitus parvam quantitatem spiritualis distribuere posset et facile manipulabatur.

source: Even with Precision, its consumption of spirituality wasn’t significant.
target: Etiam cum Praecisione, eius consumptio spiritualis non gravis erat.

source: Lumian also felt a significant enhancement in his spirituality.
target: Lumian etiam augmentationem notabilem spiritualitatis suae sensit.

source: His mind cleared, and his life force intensified.
target: Mens eius claram facta est, et vis vitae eius intensificata est.

source: He could compress flames to a blazing white state in an incredibly short time, merging with flaming spears and swiftly covering dozens to hundreds of meters.
target: Poterat flammas in statum albus ardentem in tempore brevissimo comprimere, cum hastis igneis coalescens et celeriter per decem ad centena metra percurrens.

source: Ignoring the spirituality consumption, he could travel using this method.
target: Consumptione spiritualitatis negligente, hoc modo iter facere poterat.

source: While Lumian’s strength, speed, and physique had improved, he was still not resilient enough to withstand a bullet with his body.
target: Quamquam vis, celeritas atque habitus corporal Lumiani meliores fuerunt, nondum tamen robustus fuit ut globulum telae corpore sustineret.

source: At the entrance of the mostly collapsed male bathroom in the Matani Import and Export Shop, the silver-white full-body armor burst out, wielding a light-condensed hammer in both hands.
target: Ad ostium latrinae masculinae paene collapsae in Taberna Matani Importationis et Exportationis, lorica totius corporis argenteo-alba erupit, utrisque manibus malo compresso leviter condensato utebatur.

source: It searched left and right but couldn’t locate its target.
target: Sinistram atque dextram exploravit, sed scopum suum invenire non potuit.

source: Gradually, it seemed to “calm down.”
target: Gradatim videbatur se quietare.

source: From a nearby shadow, Franca emerged, her eyes assessing Kolobo within the half-collapsed bathroom.
target: Ex umbra proxima Franca emersit, oculis Kolobo intra latrinam semiruentem despectans.

source: His life wasn’t at risk, but his injuries were significant, and he appeared weakened.
target: Vita eius non in periculo erat, sed vulnera eius gravia erant, atque videbatur debilitatus.

source: He’ll be Pride Armor’s next target… Franca thought quickly.
target: Iste erit meta proximus Pride Armor… Franca celeriter putavit.

source: Seizing the moment while Pride Armor was still on the lookout for the backstabber and hadn’t chosen a new target, she swiftly approached.
target: Tempore utens, dum Pride Armor adhuc latro insidiator vigilabat et novum scopum non elegerat, illa celeriter accessit.

source: Franca grabbed the motionless silver full-body armor and deftly stowed it into her Traveler’s Bag.
target: Franca loricam totius corporis argenteam immobilis arripuit et perite in sacculo Viatoris recondidit.

source: “Meet up with Jenna!” Franca called out to Anthony, positioned outside the corridor.
target: “Convenite cum Jenna!” Franca Antonio, foris in corridoro collocato, exclamavit.

source: In an instant, she melted into the shadows, disappearing from sight.
target: In momento, umbras sibi obnubilata, ex conspectu evanescebat.

source: Surveying his newfound abilities, Lumian felt a surge of delight.
target: Novas facultates considerans, Lumian impetum laetitiae sensit.

source: Is this Reaper…
target: Hicne Messor est…

source: If I were to confront Hisoka now, breaking through his defenses wouldn’t be a concern.
target: Si Hisokam nunc adversarer, defensionibus eius transgredi non esset causa anxietatis.

source: My craving for combat and slaughter has intensified…
target: Cupiditas mea in proelium et caedem intensificata est…

source: Having adapted to the changes in his body, Lumian turned to Hela and expressed his gratitude.
target: Ad corporales mutationes consuetas receptus, Lumian ad Hela se vertit et gratiam suam expressit.

source: “Thank you.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago.”

source: Hela, not seeing any cause for gratitude, sighed and commented, “Your team’s teamwork is impressive.”
target: Hela, non agnovens rationem gratiarum, suspiravit et inquit, “Operae vestrae cooperatio mirabilis est.”

source: “Madame Hela, the ritual has succeeded, but I wish to enter Hisoka’s dream again and inquire about something else,” Lumian requested.
target: “Domina Hela, ritus successit, sed somnium Hisokae iterum intrare atque de alio quaerere volo,” Lumian rogavit.

source: Hela nodded in agreement.
target: Hela consentiens annuit.

source: “The ritual requires him to remain lucid.
target: “Ritus exigit ut lucidum maneat.

source: He might lie, but the questioning doesn’t need him to be lucid.”
target: Potest mentiri, sed quaestio non requirit ut lucidum maneat.”

source: As she finished speaking, Lumian suddenly closed his eyes, slumping to the ground against a dilapidated stone pillar.
target: Dum loquebatur, Lumian subito oculos clausit et contra columnam lapideam dilapsam in terram collapsus est.

source: The corners of his mouth remained curled up, and his expression gradually turned calm.
target: Anguli oris eius incurvati manserunt, et vultus eius paulatim placidus factus est.

source: In the dream’s interrogation room, Lumian took a seat across from Hisoka and addressed the captive, whose malice and desire to kill were no longer concealed.
target: In conclavi interrogationis somniorum, Lumian sedeo adversus Hisoka locutus est captivo, cuius malitia et occidendi desiderium amplius non celabantur.

source: “Thank you for your help. I’ve become a Reaper.”
target: “Gratias tibi ago pro auxilio. Messor factus sum.”

source: Hisoka, leaning forward, seemed to forget that he could attack.
target: Hisoka, se inclinans, videbatur oblitus esse se pugnare posse.

source: “So what if you’re a Reaper? In a duel, I’d still kill you easily!
target: “Quid, si Messor sis? In duello tamen te facile interficerem!

source: If you hadn’t joined forces with Hidden Blade and relied on numbers, you would have been dead!”
target: Si cum Occulta Lamine non sociavisses et numeris non innixus esses, mortuus esses!

source: No longer lucid, he’s finally revealing his true thoughts in the dream…
target: Iam non lucidus, tandem vera cogitationes suas in somnio effert…

source: Lumian chuckled and responded, “If I can create an opportunity to fight with numbers, why should I face you one-on-one?
target: Lumian risu effusus respondit, “Si casum pro pugnanda cum numeris creare possim, cur te uno contra unum oppugnarem?

source: My companions are also a part of my strength.”
target: Comites mei quoque partem virium mearum constituunt.”

source: Hisoka spoke with malice, “Do you truly trust that Hypnotist?
target: Hisoka, cum malitia, dixit, “Num vere illi Hypnotistae confidas?

source: “It’s very dangerous to open up your body and mind to a Hypnotist.
target: “Valde periculosum est corpus et mentem ad Hypnotistam aperire.

source: Aren’t you afraid that he’ll take the opportunity to leave some hidden cues that will unknowingly bring you under his control?”
target: Nonne tibi timendum est ne occasionem capiat ut aliquas signa abscondita relinquat quae te nescienter sub eius imperio inducant?

source: Lumian gazed at Hisoka for a moment before breaking into a smile.
target: Lumian Hisokam per momentum aspexit, deinde risum efferens.

source: “Perhaps that’s why I defeated you. No wonder Mad Lady said you weren’t pure enough.
target: “Forsitan ideo te vicissem. Non mirum est quod Domina Mad Lady dixit te non satis purum esse.

source: “Firstly, I do trust him. We’ve been through life and death together.
target: “Primum, illum confido. Vita et mors simul percursus sumus.

source: Secondly, I’m willing to take such a risk to kill all of you!”
target: “Secundo, ad talem periculum sum promptus ut omnes interficiam!”

source: Straightening up, Lumian locked eyes with Hisoka, enunciating each word, “Even if I plunge into the Abyss, even if I descend into hell, I shall witness your tragic demise!”
target: Surgens, Lumian oculos cum Hisoka composuit, singula verba articulans, “Etiamsi in Abyssum demersus, etiamsi in inferos descenderim, tuam tragicam ruinationem percipiam!”

source: Hisoka fell silent.
target: Hisoka tacebat.

source: Lumian eased back into his seat, composed himself, and casually inquired, “I learned from Devilology that a Devil requires a ritual to advance to Desire Apostle.
target: Lumian ad sedem revertens, se composuit ac leviter interrogavit, “Ex Devilologia didici quod Diaboli ritus necessarius est ad Apostolum Desiderii progrediendum.

source: It’s best if it’s a special serial killing ritual.
target: Optimum est, si id sit ritus specialis caedum seriatim.

source: However, other than the one four years ago, there’s only been one in Port Pylos recently.
target: Nisi unum quod quattuor annis abhinc fuit, nuper in Portu Pylos tantum unum evenit.

source: Furthermore, I’ve already killed the murderer.
target: Praeterea, iam homicidam interfeci.

source: How did you advance?
target: Quomodo progredieris?

source: “With a boon? You couldn’t have become a Desire Apostle four years ago, could you?”
target: “Cum beneficio? Non potuisti quattuor annis abhinc Apostolus Desiderii fieri, an non?”

source: Hisoka responded with a smile, “Just because you don’t know doesn’t mean it didn’t happen.”
target: Hisoka cum risu respondit, “Quia nescis, non oportet id non accidisse.”

source: Lumian’s heart stirred.
target: Cor Lumiani commotum est.

source: “Was one of those two pranks to cover up your advancement ritual?”
target: “Fuitne unum ex illis duobus iocis ad ritum progressionis tuum celandum?”

source: Lumian ventured, drawing from the scattered information he had gleaned from the peripheral members of April Fool’s.
target: Lumian audacter dixit, ex informationibus distributis ab membris laterum Aprilis Stultorum perceptis.

source: They were like scattered pieces of a puzzle, each offering a fragment of the truth but lacking the full picture.
target: Erant quasi fragmenta dispersa aenigmatis, quae singula veritatis particulam afferebant, sed imaginem plenam deficiebant.

source: The tales spoke of chaos unleashed: a disappearance of gold in the depths of Devise, and a clash between townsfolk and a primitive tribe in Tizamo Town, resulting in tragedy.
target: Fabulae de chao soluto narrabant: de auro in profundis Devise evanescente, ac de congressu inter incolas et tribum primitivam in oppido Tizamo, qui tristitiam attulit.

source: Lumian suspected that Hisoka’s advancement ritual had been shrouded within the chaos of Tizamo’s prank.
target: Lumian suspicabatur ritum progressionis Hisoka intra chaos ioci Tizamo latitus esse.

source: Hisoka’s eyes sparkled with approval, his tone paternal.
target: Oculi Hisoka approbatione fulgebant, et tonus eius paternelis erat.

source: “You’re quite perceptive.”
target: “Es valde perspicax.”

source: Lumian seized the moment to shift the conversation.
target: Lumian occasionem arripuit ut sermonem mutaret.

source: “What’s up with the Nois family’s Demon?”
target: “Quid de daemone familiae Nois agitur?”

source: He treaded cautiously, sidestepping the Celestial Worthy and the Mother Tree of Desire, for now.
target: Cautus ambulavit, praeteriens “Celestem Dignum” et “Arborem Matrem Desiderii” pro tempore.

source: Hisoka’s expression turned cold.
target: Vultus Hisoka frigore affectus est.

source: “I aimed to utilize him to acquire something and carry out a ritual to appease him repeatedly, but he only formed a connection with me.
target: “Eum adhibere intendebam, ut aliquid acquireretur et ritum ad eum saepe adplacandum peragrer, sed ille solum cum me coniunctionem instituit.

source: He only granted me an opportunity two years ago.”
target: Ille mihi tantum occasum duos annos abhinc dedit.

source: Something… Two years ago… The pranks in the gold mine city and the town of Tizamo took place after this.
target: Aliquid… Duos annos abhinc… Ioci in urbe fodinarum auri et in oppido Tizamo post hoc evenere.

source: One happened at the close of the preceding year, while the other unfolded at the close of last year…
target: Unum finem anni praeteriti attigit, alter in fine ultimi anni evenit…

source: Lumian started suspecting that these two pranks might have motives beyond concealing the advancement ritual.
target: Lumian suspicari coepit hos duos iocos habere causas extra ritum progressionis celandum.

source: Before he could delve deeper, Hisoka asked vehemently and frenziedly, “Why didn’t you seek the Tarot Club’s assistance this time?”
target: Priusquam altius indagare posset, Hisoka vehementer et furenter quaesivit, “Cur hoc tempore auxilium Societatis Taroti non quaesivisti?”

source: Lumian arched his eyebrows and inquired with confusion, “Why does it matter to you? Even without the Tarot Club’s aid, I could have successfully dealt with you.”
target: Lumian supercilia arcuit et, confusus, interrogavit, “Cur te refert? Etiamsi Societatis Taroti auxilium non haberem, te efficaciter tractare potuissem?”
